title: Enemy art: integrate PixelLab pixel-art enemy sprites (AnimatedSprite2D + state-driven enemy AnimationController) for the 3 sector_02 combat enemies, replacing the greybox ColorRects
description:
Replace the placeholder greybox (Sprite ColorRect, plus Shield Drone's extra Shield ColorRect) in scenes/empire_drone.tscn, scenes/shield_drone.tscn, scenes/charger.tscn with real PixelLab pixel-art sprites, mirroring the proven hero pipeline (TASK-052). The 3 characters were generated 2026-06-06 in the gitignored AssetBundles/character/ area (16-bit McFarlane style, side view, 8 directions, humanoid template):
- Empire Drone (ELEC armor, weak to Ice): character_id e70ad1d9-ffaa-45f2-9281-3878bf6196c5, 68x68, teal/grey armored guardian robot.
- Shield Drone (ICE armor, weak to Fire): character_id b0aca2f8-efc9-413e-8676-3463293dc867, 68x68, frost-blue armored robot.
- Charger (FIRE armor, weak to Elec): character_id e09ba82f-b462-4d5b-bf10-a179547a5656, 92x92, dark iron + molten-orange automaton.

DESIGN NOTE (confirmed with the human): create_character only offers a bipedal humanoid skeleton, so the two flying drones came out as bipedal armored robots, not floating orbs. The human chose to KEEP them, re-themed as 'armored Empire guardians' (reinforces pillar 1 tragic-quarantine tone). Color reads: Shield Drone blue=ICE ok, Charger orange=FIRE ok, Empire Drone came out teal (could be retried for a stronger ELEC-yellow read as a DIRECT tweak later).

ANIMATION SET (generated east-only via animate_character template mode, 1 gen/dir; west via flip_h, same as hero):
- Drones (Empire + Shield): idle (breathing-idle), walk (walking), attack (fireball cast pose, ranged one-shot), hurt (taking-punch one-shot).
- Charger: idle (breathing-idle), walk (walking), windup (crouching, telegraph tell), charge (running-slide, lunge), hurt (taking-punch).

FSM STATE -> ANIMATION MAPPING (enemies emit StateMachine.state_changed):
- DronePatrolState -> idle (loop); DroneChaseState -> walk (loop); DroneAttackState -> attack (one-shot, return to movement); hurt on a landed hit; death -> hold last hurt frame (gap, like hero).
- ChargerPatrolState -> idle; ChargerChaseState -> walk; ChargerWindUpState -> windup (telegraph); ChargerChargeState -> charge; ChargerRecoveryState -> idle/stagger fallback; hurt on landed hit; death -> hold hurt frame.

TECHNICAL STEPS (mirror TASK-052):
1. Download each character (PixelLab download URL) into the gitignored AssetBundles/character/ area; copy ONLY the used EAST PNGs into assets/sprites/enemies/<name>/<anim>/frame_xxx.png. Add PixelLab credit lines to assets/CREDITS.md.
2. Import as pixel art: per-node texture_filter=1 (nearest) on each enemy AnimatedSprite2D (NOT the global default, to spare the downscaled M2 parallax) + no mipmaps.
3. Build resources/enemies/<name>_frames.tres (SpriteFrames) via a reproducible tools/build_enemy_frames.gd (one builder, looping the 3 enemies + their anim maps with fps + loop flags), like tools/build_hero_frames.gd.
4. In each enemy .tscn: replace the Sprite (and Shield) ColorRect with an AnimatedSprite2D named 'Sprite'. CRITICAL: measure the opaque bbox and set offset + INTEGER scale so the feet seat on the bottom of the UNCHANGED RectangleShape2D collision (Empire/Shield 28x36, Charger 36x44). Collision shapes stay BYTE-IDENTICAL. Keep the HP Label.
5. Add scripts/enemies/enemy_animation_controller.gd: a REUSABLE controller listening to state_changed + reading velocity/facing/attacking/hurt, with a PURE unit-testable select_animation(state_name, vel, attacking, hurt) -> anim_name per enemy family (drone vs charger state names). Reuse, do not copy, the hero controller's flip_h + one-shot patterns.
6. Wire each enemy script to fire the attack/hurt one-shots and drive flip_h from facing.
7. Tests + CI: unit-test the mapping function(s); assert each enemy .tscn loads headless; assert every RectangleShape2D collision is byte-identical (this is the gameplay-safety gate); GUT crucial(61) + full suites green; gdlint clean.

SAFETY: NOT a loose visual tweak — it touches enemy scripts + adds a testable controller, so FULL ceremony applies (developer tests-first -> reviewer block-on-HIGH -> PR -> CI). Collision/AI/combat behavior (patrol/chase/attack/windup/charge/recovery, projectiles, corridor metrics, boss reachability) must be unchanged. fps/which-idle/offset fine-tuning afterwards is a DIRECT playtest tweak. Warden (boss) + Swarmling are OUT OF SCOPE (separate follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: scenes/empire_drone.tscn, scenes/shield_drone.tscn, scenes/charger.tscn render the PixelLab pixel-art enemies via AnimatedSprite2D (greybox Sprite + Shield ColorRects removed); pixel-art imports with nearest filter (no blur).
Each enemy animates per its FSM: drones idle/walk + one-shot attack on cast + hurt on a landed hit; charger idle/walk/windup/charge + hurt; left/right via flip_h from facing (east frames only).

Every RectangleShape2D collision is byte-identical (Empire/Shield 28x36, Charger 36x44) and feet visually seat on the collision bottom (measured opaque bbox); AI/combat/corridor/boss-reachability behavior unchanged.
resources/enemies/*_frames.tres are built reproducibly by tools/build_enemy_frames.gd; used PNGs live under assets/sprites/enemies/ with PixelLab credit in assets/CREDITS.md.
The state->animation selection is a pure unit-tested function (reusable enemy_animation_controller.gd); all three enemy scenes load headless; GUT crucial(61) + full suites green; gdlint clean.
Death has no dedicated anim -> documented fallback (hold last hurt frame); Empire Drone teal-vs-ELEC-yellow color read flagged as an optional DIRECT retry; Warden + Swarmling explicitly out of scope.

comments.body: DONE (local, NOT pushed — awaiting human go per repo etiquette). Tests-first developer -> independent reviewer ACCEPT (no HIGH). Branch task-056-enemy-sprites off master, 3 commits (ef2794e tests, ff20680 art+builder, 87dda83 feat). Replaced the greybox ColorRects of empire_drone/shield_drone/charger with PixelLab pixel-art AnimatedSprite2D + a reusable state-driven scripts/enemies/enemy_animation_controller.gd (pure unit-tested select_animation over both drone + charger state names, hurt/attack one-shot priority, flip_h from facing). Art east-only in assets/sprites/enemies/ (13 anims, 71 PNGs; PixelLab chars e70ad1d9/b0aca2f8/e09ba82f, 16-bit McFarlane; AssetBundles/ stays gitignored); SpriteFrames built reproducibly by tools/build_enemy_frames.gd. Per-node texture_filter=1 (nearest, NOT global, to spare the M2 parallax). SAFETY GATE HELD: all collisions byte-identical (drones 28x36, charger body 36x44 + LungeHitbox 48x40), feet seated 0.00px (integer scale 1), AI/projectile/ShieldLogic untouched. color->modulate migration verified correct (blink/tint/dissolve). Verified GREEN independently by reviewer: full GUT 834/834, crucial 61/61, gdlint clean, headless --import OK. Reviewer MEDIUM (-> follow-up TASK-057): shield_drone lost its VISUAL shield tell (block logic intact but the up/down cue is now invisible; readability regression). LOWs: controller _on_animation_finished could use elif (harmless given mutually-exclusive one-shots); Empire Drone reads teal not ELEC-yellow (optional DIRECT recolor). PLAYTEST ITEMS (headless can't verify): on-screen size/seating/fps feel; armor modulate-tint readability over the pixel art; Empire Drone color. Warden + Swarmling remain greybox (out of scope).
